processes.name: Chart of accounts & ledger
processes.description: Seed chart of accounts → post journal entries → trial balance → reverse / soft-close. Finance transactions desk.

steps.name: Seed / maintain chart of accounts
steps.tipWhat: Ensure accounts exist for posting (seed COA or add accounts).
steps.tipPitfall: Posting to a missing account code fails the journal.

steps.name: Post journal entry
steps.tipWhat: Post a balanced debit/credit journal to the ledger.
steps.tipPitfall: Unbalanced lines are rejected.

steps.name: Review trial balance
steps.tipWhat: Check trial balance after posting.
steps.tipPitfall: Ignoring TB drift after bulk posts.

steps.name: Reverse or soft-close period
steps.tipWhat: Reverse a bad journal or soft-close the period when ready.
steps.tipPitfall: Soft-close does not replace a full year-end close.

processes.name: Purchase order
processes.description: Happy path: create PO → send → confirm receipt → payable → payment → vendor paid. Implemented on the SCM desk.

processes.name: Make to stock
processes.description: Release production → start → complete (OPEN lot) → quality check → PASS releases stock. Shop floor.

steps.name: Release production order
steps.tipWhat: Release a draft production order so the floor can start it.
steps.tipPitfall: Completing without release skips the planned sequence but is still allowed from DRAFT.

steps.name: Start production
steps.tipWhat: Mark the order in progress on the floor.
steps.tipPitfall: Starting a cancelled order is blocked.

steps.name: Complete production (create lot)
steps.tipWhat: Finish the make order. For goods this creates an OPEN lot — stock is not posted yet.
steps.tipPitfall: Expecting on-hand to rise at complete — it rises only after QA PASS.

steps.name: Quality check (PASS / FAIL / HOLD)
steps.tipWhat: Inspect the lot. PASS releases quantity into stock; FAIL rejects; HOLD quarantines.
steps.tipPitfall: Skipping QA leaves finished goods invisible in on-hand.

steps.name: Stock available (on hand)
steps.tipWhat: After PASS, a PRODUCTION stock move posts and on-hand increases.
steps.tipPitfall: Manual lots for stock already on hand do not post a second receipt on PASS.

processes.name: Quote to sales order
processes.description: Create quote → send → accept → confirm sales order (optional draft invoice). Sales desk.

steps.name: Create customer quote
steps.tipWhat: Start a quote for a customer with lines and amounts.
steps.tipPitfall: Missing customer or empty lines block sending.

steps.name: Send quote
steps.tipWhat: Mark the quote sent so the customer can respond.
steps.tipPitfall: Editing after send can confuse acceptance state.

steps.name: Accept quote
steps.tipWhat: Record customer acceptance of the quote.
steps.tipPitfall: Accepting the wrong quote version.

steps.name: Confirm sales order
steps.tipWhat: Confirm the sales order from the accepted quote.
steps.tipPitfall: Confirming before acceptance skips the commercial handshake.

steps.name: Optional draft invoice
steps.tipWhat: Optionally open a draft invoice for Finance to issue.
steps.tipPitfall: Draft is not payment — still issue and settle in Finance.

processes.name: Customer invoice settle
processes.description: Create invoice → issue → settle via payment rails. Finance revenue desk.

steps.name: Create invoice (draft)
steps.tipWhat: Create a draft invoice for the customer amount.
steps.tipPitfall: Settling a draft before issue leaves rails inconsistent.

steps.name: Issue invoice
steps.tipWhat: Issue the draft so the customer can pay (rails / PDF).
steps.tipPitfall: Issuing without checking amount or customer name.

steps.name: Settle / record payment
steps.tipWhat: Record payment (fiat settle, wallet address, or live BTCPay on LIVE company).
steps.tipPitfall: DEMO companies force mock settle; live BTCPay is LIVE-only.

processes.name: Service order fulfillment
processes.description: Create service order → schedule/assign → start → complete. Delivery desk.

processes.name: Customer inquiry
processes.description: Create inquiry → start work → resolve → close. After-sales desk.

processes.name: Return merchandise (RMA)
processes.description: Request RMA → confirm (stock receipt) → close. After-sales desk.

steps.name: Create RMA request
steps.tipWhat: Open a return case for a sold product.
steps.tipPitfall: Confirming posts stock — cancel is blocked after confirm.

steps.name: Confirm RMA (receipt)
steps.tipWhat: Confirm the return; system posts an SCM stock receipt.
steps.tipPitfall: Cannot cancel once confirmed if stock already posted.

steps.name: Close RMA
steps.tipWhat: Close the return case when handling is done.
steps.tipPitfall: Leaving confirmed RMAs open clutters the open list.

processes.name: Hire candidate
processes.description: Create candidate → advance stages → hire → HR file. HR desk.

processes.name: Project lifecycle
processes.description: Create project → start → complete or cancel. Capability hub.

processes.name: IT support ticket
processes.description: Open ticket → start work → resolve → close. Digital desk.

steps.name: Open ticket
steps.tipWhat: Log an IT support request.
steps.tipPitfall: Missing priority or kind slows triage.

steps.name: Start work
steps.tipWhat: Pick up the ticket and start work.
steps.tipPitfall: Starting a closed or cancelled ticket is blocked.

steps.name: Resolve ticket
steps.tipWhat: Mark the issue resolved for requester confirmation.
steps.tipPitfall: Resolving without a note leaves no audit trail.

steps.name: Close ticket
steps.tipWhat: Close after confirmation or timeout.
steps.tipPitfall: Cannot close a cancelled ticket.

processes.name: IT change
processes.description: Plan change → start → complete (or cancel). Digital desk — tech change, not org change.

steps.name: Plan IT change
steps.tipWhat: Create or schedule a planned IT change.
steps.tipPitfall: Org/HR changes belong under Capability → Changes, not here.

steps.name: Start change
steps.tipWhat: Begin executing the planned change window.
steps.tipPitfall: Starting DONE or CANCELLED is blocked.

steps.name: Complete change
steps.tipWhat: Mark the change done after verification.
steps.tipPitfall: Completing a cancelled change is blocked.

steps.name: Or cancel change
steps.tipWhat: Cancel before completion if the window is aborted.
steps.tipPitfall: Cannot cancel a DONE change.

processes.name: HITL approval
processes.description: Submit agent proposal → human approve or reject. Agents hub.
